question: During labour in a woman with gestational diabetes mellitus, the target blood glucose range is 4–7 mmol/L (72–126 mg/dL) to prevent neonatal hypoglycaemia.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The intrapartum glucose target is 4–7 mmol/L. Hyperglycaemia in labour drives fetal insulin secretion and causes hypoglycaemia in the neonate after delivery.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Maintaining maternal glucose between 4–7 mmol/L (approximately 72–126 mg/dL) during labour minimises the risk of fetal hyperinsulinaemia and subsequent neonatal hypoglycaemia.
